description: Record of a single amendment / repeal / insertion applied to a statute article. `supersedesArticleDid` points at the prior-version article DID; the new version is addressable as a separate `com.etzhayyim.apps.houbun.article` record (new blake3 hash). See ADR-0052.

statuteRef.description: AT URI of the affected statute record.

articleRef.description: AT URI of the new (post-amendment) article record. Omitted for whole-statute repeals.

supersedesArticleDid.description: Article DID being replaced. NULL for pure insertions.

amendingStatuteRef.description: AT URI of the statute that enacted this amendment, if available.

diffUri.description: Optional pointer to a unified diff / HTML diff published by the source.

props.description: Opaque JSON string for source-specific metadata.
